message.content: Painting the entire Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that usually takes a dedicated crew several weeks to complete. In practice, the tower’s iron framework is repainted roughly every seven years, and the actual painting process typically lasts around **two to three months** (about 8–12 weeks) when carried out by a professional team.
